name: Shieldmaidens
headerMeta: Golden era · Shield infantry · blob/anti-ranged anchor · 280 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: A hyper-micro shield anchor that buffs blob and shreds heroes if played at full capacity — weapon-swap cooldown management is everything. High burst (Claymores, Yorkist) and spacing units will delete it if you lose rhythm.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Consistent in all scenarios. Mandatory per Amya.

battleRole.positioning: Plant in formation via spell 1 (circle placement, +250 defence buff once settled); then activate spell 2 cover-commander and swap to sword mode — lock inputs and hold position. {1} Reset cover-commander before engages when possible; its hidden passive damage-reduction decays 60% → 30% over 5s. {1}
battleRole.tips: Weapon-swap (spell 3) is the core loop: both stances' swaps carry CC-immunity and reset stance. {1} Spear→sword after any hit: +500 Piercing/Slashing Armour Penetration per soldier for 10s. {1} Sword→spear: restores 2% max health/s per soldier for 10s. {1} Stack swaps indefinitely off one random hit on downtime. {1} Sword-mode shield-bash (spell 2) ends in a weaker cover-commander than spear-mode — 'don't get baited.' {1} When you have time: sword charge (spell 1, void-cast for +20% atk buff to allies) → swap to spear → formation (spell 1) → cover-commander (spell 2) → swap to sword and freeze. {1} When you DON'T have time: start spear → formation (spell 1) → cover-commander (spell 2) → swap to sword and freeze. {1}

controls.notes: Formation (spell 1) places unit at circle centre and applies +250 def buff once settled {1}. Cover-commander (spell 2, spear-mode) applies hidden 60%→30%-over-5s damage-reduction passive — reset before fights {1}. Weapon-swap (spell 3) carries CC-immunity, resets stance, removes existing CC, and triggers the stance-swap buff for 10s: spear→sword = +500 AP per soldier; sword→spear = 2% max HP regen/s per soldier {1}. Stack the swaps indefinitely off one random hit on downtime {1}. Sword-mode shield-bash (spell 2) ends in weaker cover-commander — avoid unless CC-immunity needed {1}. X-move or shield-bash while in sword-mode cover-commander will cancel it; CC-immunity doctrine is safe to use {1}.
